decks.notes: The deck revolves around quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures or spells, then using instant reanimation effects to bring them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. Key cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Faithful Mending allow the player to cheat out big threats like Griselbrand or Atraxa, while also disrupting opponents with Thoughtseize and Force of Negation. By efficiently cycling through the deck with Psychic Frog and Ephemerate, the player can set up the perfect reanimation play and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and game-changing spells.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and card advantage engines. The deck aims to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also generating card advantage and filtering through the deck for key cards. Narset, Parter of Veils helps in shutting down opponent's draw power, while cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Orim's Chant provide additional disruption. The deck also utilizes a companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, as an additional way to enhance its control elements.

The deck focuses on using cards that allow for graveyard manipulation and control in order to fill up the graveyard with creatures, specifically those with high mana costs, and then using Living End to bring them all onto the battlefield at once. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Negation and Sink into Stupor to control the opponent's board state while setting up the combo. The key strategy is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures, especially high-impact ones, and then cast Living End to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden wave of creatures.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and powerful enchantments to overwhelm opponents quickly. By combining creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Starfield Shepherd with enchantments like Witch Enchanter and Guide of Souls, the deck is able to generate a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of cards like Thraben Charm and Ephemerate provide additional versatility and removal options. The mana base is structured to support the aggressive game plan, with lands like Flagstones of Trokair and Windswept Heath allowing for consistent multi-color casting. This deck aims to curve out efficiently and apply pressure from the early turns onwards.

The deck focuses on using a combination of aggressive creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage. The key strategy involves utilizing Leyline of the Guildpact to boost creature power, while cards like Quantum Riddler and Scion of Draco provide additional support and synergy. Cards like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames are used for direct damage, while Stubborn Denial and Spell Snare help protect key cards. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, ensuring that the deck can execute its game plan efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing the power of Broodscale Bloodchief in combination with various Eldrazi creatures and support cards to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Ancient Stirrings, Urza's Saga, and Blade of the Bloodchief, the deck can quickly assemble the pieces needed to unleash devastating attacks. Additionally, cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command provide valuable removal and disruption options, ensuring that the deck can control the pace of the game and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to overpower the opponent while controlling the board with removal spells and counters. The deck focuses on getting Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog onto the battlefield quickly using ramp spells like Green Sun's Zenith and Eldrazi Temple. Cards like Fight Rigging and Ugin's Labyrinth provide control elements to slow down the opponent, allowing the Eldrazi to dominate the game. Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command also help to control the board while dealing damage to the opponent.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to play aggressively and efficiently by utilizing cheap and impactful spells such as Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, along with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently through pump spells like Mutagenic Growth and Monstrous Rage, while also maintaining card advantage with Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. By utilizing a mix of burn spells, creatures, and cantrips, the deck aims to outpace and overwhelm the opponent in a fast-paced Modern format.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to quickly build a strong board presence and overwhelm your opponent with aggressive plays. By incorporating cards that synergize well with artifacts and using cards like Mishra's Bauble to draw additional cards, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board state and apply pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Pithing Needle and Tormod's Crypt to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain control of the game. The aim is to win as quickly as possible through efficient use of artifacts and aggressive tactics.

This deck focuses on using Broodscale Bloodchief's ability to sacrifice creatures and pay life to create an overwhelming board presence. It also utilizes various combos such as Glaring Fleshraker and Sowing Mycospawn to generate advantage and control the game. The deck aims to ramp up quickly and disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own resources. By combining powerful creatures and spells, the deck creates a synergistic engine that overwhelms the opponent and secures victory through a mix of aggression and control.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures, then use spells like Goryo's Vengeance to bring them back onto the battlefield for a devastating combo play. Cards like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending help dig for combo pieces, while Force of Negation and Psychic Frog provide protection and disruption against opponents. Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Quantum Riddler create additional value and synergy within the deck. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful reanimated creatures and control elements to secure victory.

This deck focuses on using ramp spells and mana acceleration to quickly bring out powerful Eldrazi creatures, overwhelming the opponent with their size and abilities. The deck also utilizes control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy, ensuring that the Eldrazi can dominate the battlefield. By efficiently ramping up mana and using powerful creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog, this deck aims to control the game and secure victory through sheer force and strategic play.

The deck focuses on using creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield effects to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining aggressive creatures with blinking effects like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can repeatedly trigger these effects to maintain tempo and outvalue the opponent. Additionally, cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide disruption and removal to clear a path for the aggressive creatures to attack. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive threats and disruptive plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Delighted Halfling to generate mana and ramp up quickly, allowing for explosive plays such as casting Craterhoof Behemoth or fetching powerful creatures with Green Sun's Zenith. Leyline of Abundance helps further accelerate mana production, while Nature's Rhythm and Birds of Paradise provide additional mana fixing. The toolbox aspect of the deck comes from the variety of creatures available to search for with Green Sun's Zenith, including Vizier of Remedies for infinite combos with Devoted Druid. Karn, the Great Creator is included for versatile artifact hate and utility.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources and disrupting their mana base through land destruction effects such as Cleansing Wildfire and Field of Ruin. It also aims to maintain board control with removal spells like Solitude and Path to Exile, while employing powerful finishers like Avengers Disassembled and Wrath of the Skies. The deck utilizes a mix of white and red mana sources, with the addition of companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard for additional value. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own board presence for a decisive victory.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Tower, Power Plant) to ramp into powerful colorless threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The deck also utilizes disruption spells like Kozilek's Command and Dress Down to control the game and disrupt opponents' strategies. Devourer of Destiny and Emrakul, the Promised End provide additional win conditions in the late game. The sideboard includes cards like Abstergo Entertainment and Boseiju, Who Endures to help against specific matchups. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm opponents with powerful threats.
